versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2

- No file or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and instructions remain identical to the previous version.

Initial release of the TestDino OpenClaw skill for Playwright CI intelligence.

- Connects OpenClaw to TestDino for real-time CI insights via mcporter.
- Provides plain-English queries to check test failures, flaky tests, run history, and CI health.
- Includes command templates for checking test run causes, flaky patterns, manual test cases, and spec files.
- Guides users through missing parameters with clear follow-up prompts.
- Implements strict time range parsing based on natural language input for accurate filtering.
